name: A Kind Thought
description: A few minutes of sending good wishes, first to yourself, then to everyone nearby. About four minutes.

cues.text: Sit quietly. Let your breathing be easy.
Think of yourself, and wish yourself something gentle: may I be at ease.
Now think of someone you care about. May you be happy.
Think of someone you see every day. May you have a good day.
Let the kind thought grow wider, to everyone nearby.
Carry the warmth with you when you go.
